items.title: File Widerspruch against Gefahrklassen-Veranlagung
items.quote: Den Widerspruch können Sie binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Musterbau-Berufsgenossenschaft, Gerüstweg 7, 30159 Musterhannover.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 19.11.2026. As a social-insurance authority letter sent by ordinary post, it counts as delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after posting per § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X (as the letter itself states: 'Als bekannt gegeben gilt der Bescheid am vierten Tag nach seiner Aufgabe zur Post') → Mon 23.11.2026 (no weekend/holiday shift applies to this fiction under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X). The one-month Widerspruch period of § 84 Abs. 1 SGG starts the next day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB, § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X) and ends one month later on the same numbered day (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB) = Wed 23.12.2026. That day is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in Niedersachsen (the BG's seat) or NW, so no further shift applies.

warnings: The letter only announces the Gefahrklasse (risk category) for 2027; it states the contribution itself will still be calculated after the year ends from reported wages, so no payment amount or payment deadline is set by this letter.

The IBAN shown in the letterhead (DE70 2505 0180 0009 8004 00) is contact information only; this letter does not ask for any payment, so there is nothing to pay against that account — double-check before ever sending money based on a letterhead IBAN alone.
